items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser keeps the skin clean without stripping or adding irritation to tender areas.
A simple barrier moisturizer supports comfort and the look of dry, tight skin without any strong actives.
A mineral SPF 50 helps keep the look of marks from appearing darker or more noticeable in the sun.

response.routine_note: Big, painful lumps under the skin that leave marks are best looked at in person by a dermatologist, so we are not recommending anything stronger from our shop. Until then, use the cleanser morning and night, the moisturizer after cleansing, and the SPF every morning, and avoid scrubs or picking.
